map.由电感与电容计算 RLC 串联电路的谐振频率。: Computes the resonant frequency of an RLC series circuit from its inductance and capacitance.
map.串联谐振频率 f₀ = 1 ÷ (2π√(LC))，其中 L 以亨利计、C 以法: Series resonant frequency f₀ = 1 ÷ (2π√(LC)), where L is in henries and C in farads (1 mH = 10⁻³ H, 1 μF = 10⁻⁶ F); with L = 1 mH and C = 1 μF, f₀ is about 5033 Hz. At resonance the inductive reactance equals the capacitive reactance, the impedance is at its minimum of a pure resistance R, and the current is at its maximum; the quality factor Q = (1 ÷ R) × √(L ÷ C), and a higher Q gives sharper frequency selection with a bandwidth BW = f₀ ÷ Q.
map.谐振时感抗与容抗相等，回路阻抗最小: At resonance the inductive and capacitive reactances are equal, so the circuit impedance is at its minimum
